name: Smart Admin Assistant – Dashboard and Site Enhancements
author: bdthemes

sections.description:
Smart Admin Assistant brings powerful admin dashboard enhancements and site optimizations in one plugin.

Simplify your admin workflows with menu and dashboard customization, custom login URL, post duplication, custom code, SMTP, login and captcha protection, role switching, database and image optimization, caching, compression, and more—all for a smarter, faster WordPress experience.

No need to install dozens of plugins! Try Smart Admin Assistant now and manage your admin dashboard without any trouble.

Try Live Demo | Get Smart Admin Assistant Pro | Read Documentation

Why Choose?

  • All-in-One Solution
  • Modular Architecture
  • Performance Optimized
  • Security First
  • Regular Updates and 24/7 Support
  • Multi-site Controlling form admin panel(Coming soon)

Look at Core Modules & Features

Admin Interface

This module creates a cleaner, personalized dashboard experience that reduces cognitive load and improves workflow efficiency. You can eliminate distractions while gaining faster access to frequently used administrative functions and better data visibility.

  • Hiding admin bar (in Backend, on Frontend)
  • Hiding admin bar for user Roles (Pro)
  • Enabling admin bar cleanup (On/Off toggle)
  • Hiding all admin notices from plugins and WordPress
  • Enabling dashboard customization—columns layout customization (Pro)
  • Enabling menu customization—Hide, Rename, Reorder, Structure control (Pro)
  • List table enhancements in the Column of Post, Page, Media Library, User list (Pro)
  • Infinite scrolling in media library (Pro)
  • Displaying active plugins first (Pro)
  • Preserving Taxonomy Hierarchy in Classic Editor
  • Adding User Role to Body Class (Frontend)
  • Adding User Info to Admin Body Class
  • Custom Footer Text(Shortcode & Basic HTML support)

Login & User Management

This module strengthens website security while providing administrators with complete visibility into user access patterns. You are able to benefit from reduced security vulnerabilities and enhanced ability to monitor and control user authentication processes effectively.

  • Enhancing security through URL obfuscation
  • Replacing default WordPress Login URL with custom slug
  • Restricting user login to username OR email address only
  • Login method limitation for security
  • Login page customization with logo, colors, URL and styling (Pro)
  • User Tracking— Last Login, IP address, and user agent (Pro)
  • Enabling logout redirection (Pro)

Performance

This module helps you reduce page load times and server strain, improving user experience and search engine rankings. Any WordPress site owners avail opportunity from automated optimization processes that require minimal technical knowledge or ongoing maintenance.

  • Limit the number of revisions stored for posts and pages
  • Reducing server load through API optimization
  • Database optimization through auto-clean expired Transients, auto-delete spam comments, auto-empty trash (Pro)
  • Automatic Image Optimization (Coming Soon)
  • Caching & Loading—GZIP Compression, Browser Caching (Pro)
  • Cache headers to allow browsers to cache static resources
  • Removing unnecessary whitespace and comments from HTML output
  • Preloading critical resources—hints for critical CSS and JS files

Security

This module provides comprehensive protection through advanced security measures, real-time threat monitoring, and vulnerability scanning to safeguard your WordPress site from malicious attacks and unauthorized access attempts.

  • CAPTCHA verification to Login & Comment form (Pro)
  • Site-wide Password protection (Coming Soon)
  • Email address protection from spam bots
  • Removing WordPress version from meta tags, RSS feeds, etc.
  • Disabling file (Theme & Plugin) editing
  • IP management—Current status, Blocked IPs, etc.

Component Disabling

This module allows selective deactivation of WordPress features and admin components you don’t need, reducing bloat and improving performance while creating a cleaner, more focused administrative experience tailored to your workflow.

  • Disabling Gutenberg globally
  • Disabling Gutenberg for specific post types
  • Disabling comments globally
  • Disabling comments for specific post types
  • Closing comments on old content
  • HTTP security headers

Custom Code

This module empowers you to implement advanced customizations without touching theme files, ensuring updates don’t break functionality. Developers like you benefit from centralized code management with backup capabilities for safer site modifications.

  • Code snippets management—creating, importing & exporting
  • Custom code integration status
  • Automatic CSS and JavaScript code minification (Pro)

Utilities

Simplifies site maintenance by providing essential diagnostic tools and automated cleanup processes. Gain peace of mind through better visibility into site health and streamlined management of routine administrative tasks.

  • Configuring custom SMTP settings for email delivery (Coming Soon)
  • Maintenance mode to show page to non-admin users
  • Displaying system information in table
  • Technical support assistance tool
  • Restoring all settings to default configuration
  • Plugin reset functionality

Content Management

This module saves time by eliminating repetitive content creation tasks while maintaining site organization. You can gain complete control over content publishing schedules and external link behavior, reducing manual oversight requirements.

  • One-click duplication of pages, posts, post meta, etc.
  • Allowed Roles – Administrator, Editor, Author, Contributor, Subscriber (Pro)
  • Edit Screen & List View (redirect option)
  • User Permission Management (Administration, Editor, Author, etc.)
  • Auto-generates post excerpts and customization (On/Off toggle)
  • Enable custom Ordering of hierarchical content (Pro)
  • Content organization management
  • Media replacement (Pro)
  • SVG file uploads, security sanitization, and file type support
  • SVG Uploads Roles—Administrator, Editor, Author, Contributor, Subscriber (Pro)
  • Automatic publishing trigger for posts with “missed schedule” status
  • Recovery mechanism for failed scheduled posts
  • Custom permalink functionality for external URLs
  • External URL configuration for pages, posts, and custom post types
  • Enabling External Permalinks (Pro)
  • Automatic rel=”noopener noreferrer” attribute addition
  • Enhanced user experience for external navigation
  • New tab opening for menu links with rel=”noopener noreferrer”
  • Manual IP Blocking

Additional

This module extends core WordPress capabilities with specialized tools for advanced user management and future-ready features. Benefit from enhanced flexibility and professional-grade functionality typically requiring multiple separate plugins.

  • Custom avatars instead of using Gravatar
  • Switching roles between users (Pro)
  • UX testing and debugging capability
  • Image size management in WordPress (Coming Soon)
  • User profiles enhancement

Who Is Smart Admin Assistant For

  • Site Owners/Administrators – Business owners, bloggers, and organizations who need specific functionality for their websites but may not have technical expertise to code solutions themselves.

  • Content Creators – Writers, marketers, and content managers who use plugins to enhance their publishing workflow, and content presentation.

  • Developers/Agencies – Web developers and agencies who use plugins as building blocks to create custom solutions for clients, extending WordPress functionality without reinventing the wheel.

  • E-commerce Users – Online store owners who rely on plugins like WooCommerce for shopping cart functionality, payment processing, and inventory management.

  • Marketing Professionals – Those using plugins for email marketing, analytics, lead generation, A/B testing, and conversion optimization.

  • Small to Medium Businesses – Companies that need professional website features like appointment booking, membership systems, or customer relationship management without custom development costs.

Smart Admin Assistant Pro

Tired of a cluttered WordPress admin area?

If you want to make your WordPress dashboard more enhanced and user-friendly, Get pro version of it available at store.bdthemes

Support & Documentation

  • Plugin Support: Available through WordPress.org support forums
  • Documentation: Comprehensive guides available on our website
  • Feature Requests: We listen to our community for future enhancements
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dark-reader folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Dark Reader to configure your dark mode settings
  4. Select your preferred toggle button style and position
  5. Save your settings and enjoy your beautiful dark mode!
sections.faq:
How does Admin Dashboard Assistant improve my WordPress website management?

It centralizes essential admin tasks, saving time and boosting productivity for a smoother, more controlled website experience.

Is this plugin suitable for beginners without technical WordPress experience?

Absolutely! It’s designed with an intuitive interface, guiding beginners through every step without coding knowledge.

Why should I choose this plugin over similar admin tools?

Our plugin offers Customization, Security, Content Management, and exclusive features not found in other admin tools.

Does the plugin include future feature updates after purchase?

Yes, all active licenses receive continuous updates to enhance features, improve security, and maintain compatibility.

Does it support multi-site WordPress installations for centralized management?

Definitely! It’s fully optimized for managing multiple WordPress sites from one convenient admin dashboard.

How many websites can I activate with one license key?

Licenses vary; choose from single-site, multi-site, or unlimited site activation depending on your needs.

Can I transfer my license to another domain later?

Yes, simply deactivate it on the old domain and activate it on your new site instantly.

Does the plugin impact my site speed or overall performance

No, it’s lightweight and optimized to ensure smooth performance without slowing your WordPress site.

How can I report security bugs?

You can report security bugs through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team helps validate, triage and handle any security vulnerabilities. Report a security vulnerability.****
